response.sql: SELECT film_id, COUNT(*) AS copies, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory) AS share FROM inventory GROUP BY film_id ORDER BY share DESC, film_id LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Only films that have at least one inventory record are listed (films with no copies are excluded), and the total is the count of all inventory rows across both stores.
Ties at the cutoff are broken by film_id, which the request permits as any tie-break is acceptable.
